result.verdict: PASS. 0 blocking findings and 6 NOTEs. The README (27cd181b) and HASHES.txt (e9acbca9) check out from their bytes. Every object and every base matches its stated sha. Each object differs from its base only on its stated pin lines, and each new pin equals its target's build bytes. In guard011 only L20 changed: the contract is now exactly {7a6af535:{79e8936d}}, and all 33 definitions have the same AST as in guard010. The honest tail-ON path PASSES end to end on the packet's own interpreter (codex runtime Python 3.12.14). The path is PRELAUNCH005 -> guard011 -> the real q5b1 wrapper 7a6af535 -> the real adapter cx2v002 -> the real R5 normalize_spec -> the (b1) guard 9e3fc109. It used a byte-copy of spec 50e7288e and synthetic certificate fixtures under claude_artifacts. It produced record fe23bd6c, and a fresh-process replay is byte-equal. launcher012's worker-mode validate and bind010's validate also pass on the bound plan. Every MUST_FAIL row is refused with the expected code at the expected line, and R1 behaves identically under guard010 and guard011. The packet_read pins equal the build bytes. cp -n publication keeps the shas. No defect is reachable from honest pinned producers, and no computed value changes.

findings.title: Root's C1 sources must list the uv-tail library owned_uv_tail_lapse_v002.py (2026f2b6). The builder's E01 could not show this.
findings.evidence: With the real adapter cx2v002, the R5 normalize_spec loads the tail library: uvt_library -> exec_verified at R5 L887. Scenario N02 drops that one source and is refused with UNPINNED_PREFLIGHT_SOURCE at guard011 L160. The builder's E01 used a synthetic adapter and 15 sources, so it never loaded the driver. This lens's minimal honest set is 16 sources: the builder's set plus 2026f2b6, with the real adapter in place of the synthetic one (lens/run1 BUILD_LOG ead305ca). A real custody deriver needs more. Codex1's 117-source candidate already includes 2026f2b6. This concerns C1 content, not the cascade.

findings.title: Publication: guard011 and launcher012 compare the plan's pins with their own loaded location. They need guard011, launcher012 and bind010 together in a non-symlinked impl/. cp -n returns 1 when the target already exists.
findings.evidence: guard011 L326 requires plan['guard']==pin(__file__) and plan['launcher']==pin(producer). pin() resolves symlinks through safe_path. launcher012 L62/83/100/126/157 pass its own __file__. bind010 L27 confines outputs to HERE.parent. The launcher lock is HERE.parent/STEP4_MACHINE_LOCK_V001, the same as launcher011's. PRELAUNCH005 only records its own path as the manifest producer, and nothing downstream checks it. step4_launch_packet_cx1/impl has no symlink component (lstat walk, TESTED). With the staged co-located layout, the whole E2E passes. Copying with cp -n into fixtures_lens/run1/pubsim keeps eb97e303, 59c00707 and 4d07dca3. A cp -n onto an existing name exits 1 and leaves the bytes unchanged, so root's publication step should stop on a nonzero exit.
